Definition: to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account
BiblicalUsage: To diminish is the word for Jacob's humility and David's wonder: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which Thou hast shewed unto Thy servant, and David says, this was yet a small thing in Thy sight, O Lord GOD.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the smallness as the right size for a man before God, and the wonder as the answer to it.
